email_subject: Application - Content Marketeer at Atlas Copco Airpower
email_body:
Dear Kate Verschragen,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Marketeer role at Atlas Copco Airpower. Your posting asks for someone who can turn technical products into clear, customer-focused content, and I've done exactly that: I built kxp.be single-handedly in English, Dutch and French, and I wrote and structured the content myself. At Episto I built ~600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I run keyword research and SEO for clients in consulting, auto and e-commerce. I also created two Dutch landing pages for a kids' bike brand and ran a Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks.

What appeals to me about Atlas Copco is the scale of the content challenge: making complex airpower solutions understandable across webpages, brochures and sales enablement platforms. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Antwerp office is no problem.

In the first weeks I'd map your existing product content and identify where clearer, customer-focused messaging can make an immediate difference. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can contribute.

Baver Ok

# Baver Ok

English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I turn products and services into clear, customer-focused content that supports sales and grows digital presence. At Episto I run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. As a freelancer I sell SEO, website and marketing automation services, and I built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress with on-page SEO and GEO for AI search in English, Dutch and French. I track rankings, traffic and CTR in GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, and I use those insights to improve content. I am analytical, follow algorithm updates closely and eager to learn.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **~600 member profile pages** built and launched on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French

- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant

- **SEO & marketing:** content marketing, SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, AI search (GEO/AEO), Google Ads Search, WooCommerce
- **Growth & sales:** landing pages, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, lead generation, A/B testing
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT, HTML/CSS, Odoo
